question: how many employees are there in each department?
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql group-by dept -count n

question: What's the average salary in each department?
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql group-by dept -avg salary avg

question: Show the names and salaries of the 3 best paid employees, highest first
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql sort salary -desc | ssql limit 3 | ssql include name salary

question: list the names of employees older than 40
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql where -if age gt 40 | ssql include name

question: which employees are not active? just their names
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql where -if status ne active | ssql include name

question: how many people were hired in 2020 or later?
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql where -if hire_date ge 2020-01-01 | ssql count

question: Count the engineers based in SF
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql where -if dept eq Engineering -if city eq SF | ssql count

question: Split employees into 'high' (salary of 100000 or more) and 'low' and count each group
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql update -set-expr band 'salary >= 100000 ? "high" : "low"' | ssql group-by band -count n

question: Who is the best paid person in each department? show the department and the name
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql group-by dept -arg-max name salary top

question: which cities do our employees work in? each city once
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql include city | ssql distinct

question: average age for each level, sorted by level ascending
golden: ssql from employees.csv | ssql group-by level -avg age avg_age | ssql sort level

question: what is the total amount across all orders?
golden: ssql from orders.csv | ssql group-by -sum amount total

question: number of orders for each product
golden: ssql from orders.csv | ssql group-by product -count n

question: What is the id and amount of the single largest order?
golden: ssql from orders.csv | ssql sort amount -desc | ssql limit 1 | ssql include order_id amount

question: count the orders in each month, labelling each month like 2024-01
golden: ssql from orders.csv | ssql update -set-expr month 'strftime(order_date, "%Y-%m")' | ssql group-by month -count n

question: for each customer tier, what is the total order amount? the tier is in customers.csv and the amounts in orders.csv
golden: ssql from customers.csv | ssql join orders.csv -using customer_id | ssql group-by tier -sum amount total

question: how many orders has each customer placed? show the customer's name and the count, only for customers with orders
golden: ssql from orders.csv | ssql join customers.csv -using customer_id | ssql group-by name -count n

question: Which customers have never placed an order? Give their names.
golden: ssql from customers.csv | ssql except -file orders.csv -using customer_id | ssql include name

question: where can I fly directly from SYD, and how many minutes does each flight take? show destination and minutes
golden: ssql from flights.csv | ssql where -if src eq SYD | ssql include dst mins

question: which flight is the longest? give its source, destination and minutes
golden: ssql from flights.csv | ssql sort mins -desc | ssql limit 1

question: list every flight with the full city names of where it starts and ends, plus the minutes (cities.csv maps the code in its city column to a name)
golden: ssql from flights.csv | ssql join cities.csv -on src city -as name src_name + -on dst city -as name dst_name | ssql include src_name dst_name mins

question: Using the flights, what is the quickest total flying time from SYD to every city you can reach? (SYD itself counts, at 0 minutes) Show each destination and the total minutes.
golden: ssql from flights.csv | ssql traverse -from src -to dst -start SYD -lowest-sum mins total | ssql include dst total
